dialogues.jp:
その次の日になっても叶が学園に姿を見せるこ
とはなかった。
dialogues.en: Kanae didn't come to school today either.
dialogues.text: Kanae didn't come to school today either.

dialogues.jp:
結局昨日は、そのまま廊下で寝てしまい、体の
節々が痛い。
dialogues.en:
I spent the whole of last night sleeping n the corridor, so
my joints were aching...
dialogues.text:
I spent the whole of last night sleeping n the corridor, so
my joints were aching...

dialogues.jp:
だがそんな体の痛みより、胸の痛みの方がこた
えた。
dialogues.en:
But even the pain from there couldn't match the pain in my
chest.
dialogues.text:
But even the pain from there couldn't match the pain in my
chest.

dialogues.jp: 楽しそうに雑談を交わすクラスメイト達。
dialogues.en:
The classmates around me were chatting among themselves
idly.
dialogues.text:
The classmates around me were chatting among themselves
idly.

dialogues.jp:
その会話の内容は、昨日見たＴＶの内容だった
り、古文の小テストの事だったり……。
dialogues.en:
About what they watched on TV yesterday, about the
literature test coming up soon...
dialogues.text:
About what they watched on TV yesterday, about the
literature test coming up soon...

dialogues.jp:
まるで叶がもとから存在しなかったかのような、
ごくごく当たり前の日常。
dialogues.en:
As if Kanae's disappearance from class was a normal everyday
thing.
dialogues.text:
As if Kanae's disappearance from class was a normal everyday
thing.

dialogues.jp:
もしかしたら叶はこのまま学園には帰ってこな
いのかもしれない……。
dialogues.en: Maybe Kanae really won't come back to school at this rate...
dialogues.text: Maybe Kanae really won't come back to school at this rate...

dialogues.jp: （そんなことある訳ない！！）
dialogues.en: "(Of course that won't happen!!)"
dialogues.text: "(Of course that won't happen!!)"

dialogues.jp: 弱気になった自分に心の中で｛しった／叱咤｝を加える。
dialogues.en: I scolded myself for being so weak.
dialogues.text: I scolded myself for being so weak.

dialogues.jp:
たとえほんの一瞬とはいえ、そんな可能性を疑
うなんて。
dialogues.en:
For even doubting it for a moment, for accepting any other
possibility.
dialogues.text:
For even doubting it for a moment, for accepting any other
possibility.

dialogues.jp: 信じるんだ……かならず叶は帰ってくる。
dialogues.en: She'd definitely come back... I have to believe so.
dialogues.text: She'd definitely come back... I have to believe so.

dialogues.jp:
俺が、俺だけは、信じてやらなければ、本当に
彼女は戻って来ないような気がした。
dialogues.en: If I don't, she really might never come back again.
dialogues.text: If I don't, she really might never come back again.

dialogues.jp: そう、叶は必ず戻ってくる……………。
dialogues.en: Right, she definitely will return......
dialogues.text: Right, she definitely will return......

dialogues.jp:
暦先生が姿を見せると、騒がしかった連中も席
についた。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei popped into the classroom, cueing the
returning to seats of my noisy classmates.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei popped into the classroom, cueing the
returning to seats of my noisy classmates.

dialogues.speaker: Weekly Duty
dialogues.jp: 「起立、礼！」
dialogues.en: "Stand up, bow!"
dialogues.text: "Stand up, bow!"

dialogues.jp: 週番の号令と共にふぞろいな礼をする。
dialogues.en: On the weekly duty's order, we simultaneously bowed.
dialogues.text: On the weekly duty's order, we simultaneously bowed.

dialogues.jp: 本当に、俺と叶以外は全ていつも通りの朝。
dialogues.en:
If you ignore Kanae and I, it's really like every other
morning.
dialogues.text:
If you ignore Kanae and I, it's really like every other
morning.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あー……今朝は皆にふたつ報せておかねばな
　らんことがある」
dialogues.en: "Ahh-.... I have two things to tell the class this morning.
dialogues.text: "Ahh-.... I have two things to tell the class this morning.

dialogues.jp:
いつもなら名簿を出すタイミングで、ふいに先生
が口を開く。
dialogues.en:
As she took out her class register as usual, she started
speaking.
dialogues.text:
As she took out her class register as usual, she started
speaking.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「わがクラスの工藤叶だが……彼は退学届を出
　した」
dialogues.en:
"Kudou Kanae from our class... he has officially dropped out
from our school."
dialogues.text:
"Kudou Kanae from our class... he has officially dropped out
from our school."

dialogues.jp:
一斉にざわめきが走る。俺は勢いよく席を立ち
上がっていた。
dialogues.en: Confusion reigned at once. I heatedly stood up at my desk.
dialogues.text: Confusion reigned at once. I heatedly stood up at my desk.

dialogues.jp: 「どういう事ですか！？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean by that!?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean by that!?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「はい、みんな静かに！　……特に朝倉、落ち
　着け」
dialogues.en:
"Alright, everyone, settle down! ... And you, Asakura, calm
down."
dialogues.text:
"Alright, everyone, settle down! ... And you, Asakura, calm
down."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ふたつめの報せを先にしなきゃならん。わが
　クラスに転入生が来たのだ」
dialogues.en:
"Like I said before, I have two things to say. A new
transfer student is taking his place."
dialogues.text:
"Like I said before, I have two things to say. A new
transfer student is taking his place."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「転入生なんてどうでもいい！　俺が知りたい
　のは叶の事だ！！」
dialogues.en:
"Who cares about that transfer student! I want to know what
happened to Kanae!!"
dialogues.text:
"Who cares about that transfer student! I want to know what
happened to Kanae!!"

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「ひどいな、朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "That's mean, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "That's mean, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp: ……その時、涼やかな声が俺を制した。
dialogues.en: ...At that moment, a cool voice reached my ears.
dialogues.text: ...At that moment, a cool voice reached my ears.

dialogues.jp: ……聞き覚えがある、この声…………………。
dialogues.en: ...I remember it, that voice.........
dialogues.text: ...I remember it, that voice.........

dialogues.jp:
目に見えない糸に惹かれるように、俺はゆっく
りとそちらを振り返った。
dialogues.en:
I slowly turned my head to face that voice that I knew
all-so-well.
dialogues.text:
I slowly turned my head to face that voice that I knew
all-so-well.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「私のこと、どうでもいいんだ」
dialogues.en: "Who cares about me, huh?"
dialogues.text: "Who cares about me, huh?"

dialogues.jp: ふわり。スカートの｛すそ／裾｝を軽やかになびかせて、
dialogues.en: There. Straigtening the hem of her skirt,
dialogues.text: There. Straigtening the hem of her skirt,

dialogues.jp: ショートカットの美少女が立っていた。
dialogues.en: a pretty girl with short hair stood.
dialogues.text: a pretty girl with short hair stood.

dialogues.jp: 叶。
dialogues.en: Kanae.
dialogues.text: Kanae.

dialogues.jp: それは、ほんとうの「工藤叶」だった。
dialogues.en: That is, the real "Kudou Kanae".
dialogues.text: That is, the real "Kudou Kanae".

dialogues.jp:
先ほどとは打って変わった、静かなざわめきが、
まるで｛さざなみ／漣｝のように広まっていく。
dialogues.en:
Unlike before, rather than a sudden burst of noise, just a
slow ripple overcame the class.
dialogues.text:
Unlike before, rather than a sudden burst of noise, just a
slow ripple overcame the class.

dialogues.jp:
クラスの連中も、どこか見覚えのあるこの少女
に対して戸惑っているのがうかがい知れた。
dialogues.en:
The classmates knew that they've seen her before, yet
couldn't place where...
dialogues.text:
The classmates knew that they've seen her before, yet
couldn't place where...

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ほれ、自己紹介だ。案の定、みんな分からん
　らしい」
dialogues.en:
"Alright, introduce yourself. Sure enough, no one got it. I
suppose that's expected, though."
dialogues.text:
"Alright, introduce yourself. Sure enough, no one got it. I
suppose that's expected, though."

dialogues.jp: どこか面白がるような口調で促す暦先生。
dialogues.en: Her tone of voice was far more amused than anything else.
dialogues.text: Her tone of voice was far more amused than anything else.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「はい、先生」
dialogues.en: "Okay, sensei."
dialogues.text: "Okay, sensei."

dialogues.jp: 叶は小さく頷くと教壇の脇に立った。
dialogues.en:
Kanae nodded, walked to the platform, and stood at it's
side.
dialogues.text:
Kanae nodded, walked to the platform, and stood at it's
side.

dialogues.jp:
礼儀正しく頭をさげ、ゆっくり教室中を見回し
てから思い切ったように口を開く。
dialogues.en:
She bowed with just the right amount of politeness, took a
quick look around the classroom, then opened her mouth
resolutely.
dialogues.text:
She bowed with just the right amount of politeness, took a
quick look around the classroom, then opened her mouth
resolutely.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「はじめまして…………になるんでしょうか。
　私の名前は、工藤叶と申します」
dialogues.en: "Nice to meet you... of sorts. My name is Kudou Kanae."
dialogues.text: "Nice to meet you... of sorts. My name is Kudou Kanae."

dialogues.jp: ざわざわと漣が広がっていく。
dialogues.en: The ripple of noise was slowly becoming a wave.
dialogues.text: The ripple of noise was slowly becoming a wave.

dialogues.speaker: Tahata
dialogues.en: "...Kudou, huh."
dialogues.text: "...Kudou, huh."

dialogues.jp:
未だ事情が飲み込めぬらしきクラスメイトたち
の間で、日頃寡黙な田端が一言を発する。
dialogues.en:
The shock of the class was evident by Tahata actually
throwing off his reticience in shock.
dialogues.text:
The shock of the class was evident by Tahata actually
throwing off his reticience in shock.

dialogues.jp:
いつもと同じくぼそりとつぶやくような口調だっ
たが、それはさながら一発の爆弾が放り込まれ
たような効果をもたらした。
dialogues.en:
It's not something he hasn't said before, but the impact of
that was enough to set bombs off around the classroom.
dialogues.text:
It's not something he hasn't said before, but the impact of
that was enough to set bombs off around the classroom.

dialogues.speaker: Guy A
dialogues.jp: 「っえ…………く……工藤って、あの娘が！？」
dialogues.en: "...What.... the.... Kudou is that girl!?"
dialogues.text: "...What.... the.... Kudou is that girl!?"

dialogues.speaker: Guy B
dialogues.jp: 「嘘だろぉおお！！？？」
dialogues.en: "This HAS to be a joke!!??"
dialogues.text: "This HAS to be a joke!!??"

dialogues.jp:
その漣は、やがて怒涛に変わり教室中を埋め尽
くした。
dialogues.en: The wave then became a tsunami, enveloping the entire class.
dialogues.text: The wave then became a tsunami, enveloping the entire class.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「やっと気兼ねなく呼べるね、叶ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "I can finally address you comfortably, Kanae-chan."
dialogues.text: "I can finally address you comfortably, Kanae-chan."

dialogues.jp: 嬉しそうな笑顔でことりが叶の肩を叩く。
dialogues.en: Kotori patted Kanae on the shoulder with a bright smile.
dialogues.text: Kotori patted Kanae on the shoulder with a bright smile.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんね、ことり。ずっと迷惑かけて」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, Kotori. I troubled you so much all this time."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, Kotori. I troubled you so much all this time."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「もー。謝る相手は、私じゃないでしょ？」
dialogues.en: "Heeeyy, I'm not the one you need to apologize to, right?"
dialogues.text: "Heeeyy, I'm not the one you need to apologize to, right?"

dialogues.jp:
と、ことりは俺に向けて小さくウインクをして
みせた。
dialogues.en: Kotori then glanced at me, giving me a small wink.
dialogues.text: Kotori then glanced at me, giving me a small wink.

dialogues.jp: 「……ことり」
dialogues.en: "...Kotori."
dialogues.text: "...Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「なるほど………………そういうことであった
　のだな、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "I see......... I finally understand, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "I see......... I finally understand, Asakura."

dialogues.jp:
いつの間にか隣に立っていた杉並が腕組みをし
てうむうむと首を上下に動かしていた。
dialogues.en:
Suginami had sneaked up beside me without my notice, folding
his arms and scratching his chin.
dialogues.text:
Suginami had sneaked up beside me without my notice, folding
his arms and scratching his chin.

dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「三年以上友として過ごしながら正体を見抜け
　なんだとは……この杉並、一生の不覚！」
dialogues.en:
"Being a friend for three years, yet not being able to see
through the facade... this failure will stay with me through
my life!"
dialogues.text:
"Being a friend for three years, yet not being able to see
through the facade... this failure will stay with me through
my life!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……だが朝倉、よくやったぞぉ。風聞や逆境
　に耐えてなお己の想い人を護り通したその立
　派さ、騎士の称号に相応しき哉！」
dialogues.en:
"...Yet for you, Asakura, who braved adversity and venomous
rumours to pursue and protect your lover, you truly are a
knight!"
dialogues.text:
"...Yet for you, Asakura, who braved adversity and venomous
rumours to pursue and protect your lover, you truly are a
knight!"

dialogues.speaker: 朝倉
dialogues.jp: 「……お前はいちいち大袈裟なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "...You're always exaggerating so damn much."
dialogues.text: "...You're always exaggerating so damn much."

dialogues.jp:
そんな大袈裟な事をいいながらも、杉並の口元
は笑みを作っていた。
dialogues.en:
I tried to get him to stop, but he had that usual grin on
his face.
dialogues.text:
I tried to get him to stop, but he had that usual grin on
his face.

dialogues.jp: その笑みを見て、ふとあることに思い至ったが、
dialogues.en: Looking at that grin made me realize something...
dialogues.text: Looking at that grin made me realize something...

dialogues.en: "Wait a minute..."
dialogues.text: "Wait a minute..."

dialogues.jp:
杉並にその事を尋ねる前に、「とっとと側にいっ
てやらんか馬鹿者」と、頭をこづかれる。
dialogues.en:
But before I could say anything further, he told me "Go to
her side, idiot", and clocked me one on the head.
dialogues.text:
But before I could say anything further, he told me "Go to
her side, idiot", and clocked me one on the head.

dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.jp: わかってるさそんなこと、言われなくてもな。
dialogues.en: I know that already, sheesh, you don't have to tell me.
dialogues.text: I know that already, sheesh, you don't have to tell me.

dialogues.jp:
そう……なんていうか、もしかしたら｛こいつ／杉並｝、本
当は全部知っていたのかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
Yeah... maybe, just maybe, that idiot knew everything from
the start as well.
dialogues.text:
Yeah... maybe, just maybe, that idiot knew everything from
the start as well.

dialogues.jp: そう考えるとあの忠告の意味も頷けた。
dialogues.en: I thought about the advice he gave me before.
dialogues.text: I thought about the advice he gave me before.

dialogues.jp: いろいろと回りくどいことしやがって。
dialogues.en: It could mean so many things though.
dialogues.text: It could mean so many things though.

dialogues.jp: ……まったくかったるい奴だよ。
dialogues.en: ...Bah, what a troublesome idiot.
dialogues.text: ...Bah, what a troublesome idiot.

dialogues.jp: ふらふらと歩み出る。
dialogues.en: I staggeredly made my way.
dialogues.text: I staggeredly made my way.

dialogues.jp: 俺の大切な女の子の前に。
dialogues.en: To my most important girl.
dialogues.text: To my most important girl.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun..."

dialogues.jp: 叶は微笑んでそっと俺の手をとった。
dialogues.en: Kanae smiled and took my hand.
dialogues.text: Kanae smiled and took my hand.

dialogues.jp:
そして、はにかみながらもしっかりとした通る
声で、クラス中に呼びかけた。
dialogues.en:
Then, using me to shyly hide herself from the rest of the
class, started addressing them through me.
dialogues.text:
Then, using me to shyly hide herself from the rest of the
class, started addressing them through me.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「私は、ほんの少しだけ変わりましたけど……
　このクラスの一員で、『工藤叶』であること
　は同じなんです」
dialogues.en:
"I may have have changed a bit... but I'm still the same
"Kudou Kanae" that was once part of this class."
dialogues.text:
"I may have have changed a bit... but I'm still the same
"Kudou Kanae" that was once part of this class."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「だから、皆さん……今までと変わらずに、仲
　良くしてくださいね」
dialogues.en: "So, everyone... just as before, let's become good friends."
dialogues.text: "So, everyone... just as before, let's become good friends."

dialogues.jp:
一点の曇りも無く｛すがすが／清々｝しいその笑顔は、｛さわ／爽｝やか
に晴れ渡る初夏の青空のようだった。
dialogues.en:
in the fresh and clear first days of summer, her smile was
even more invigorating and bright.
dialogues.text:
in the fresh and clear first days of summer, her smile was
even more invigorating and bright.

dialogues.jp: ◆転入生◆
dialogues.en: ◆Transfer Student◆
dialogues.text: ◆Transfer Student◆

dialogues.jp:
昨日、『さようなら』と言って俺の前から去っ
た叶のことが気になって仕方なかった。
dialogues.en:
Yesterday, I couldn't get the girl who told me "farewell"
out of my mind.
dialogues.text:
Yesterday, I couldn't get the girl who told me "farewell"
out of my mind.

dialogues.jp:
そんな時、暦先生から皆に信じられない話があっ
た。叶が退学届を出したと言うのだ。
dialogues.en:
Then today, Koyomi-sensei told everyone something
unbelievable; that Kanae had dropped out of the school.
dialogues.text:
Then today, Koyomi-sensei told everyone something
unbelievable; that Kanae had dropped out of the school.

dialogues.jp:
たまらず、暦先生に詰め寄る俺の耳に響いた、
懐かしい声。
dialogues.en:
Then, drawing closer to Koyomi-sensei, a voice that I held
so close to my heart.
dialogues.text:
Then, drawing closer to Koyomi-sensei, a voice that I held
so close to my heart.

dialogues.jp:
そこには真新しい本校制服に身を包んだ転入生、
工藤叶が微笑んでいた。
dialogues.en:
The new transfer student Kudou Kanae, wearing the female
uniform of the main school, was smiling.
dialogues.text:
The new transfer student Kudou Kanae, wearing the female
uniform of the main school, was smiling.
